_source: Read from the live Meridian Interface site, not chosen here. #0f172a appears 61 times in src/ and is the brand's ink; blue-600 is the only accent the site actually uses.

ink.use: Wordmark, headings, the darkest surface. The brand colour.

accent.use: Links, primary buttons. Used sparingly and never in the mark.

muted.use: Subtext, the INTERFACE line on light backgrounds.

muted_dark.use: The INTERFACE line on dark backgrounds.

lockup._note: Ratios, not pixels — the lockup scales from a favicon to a sign without redrawing.
lockup.clear_space: 0.25 x mark height on every side. Nothing enters it.
